long_biography.plain_text:
At Papendorp in Utrecht, Ton van Dam sought tenants and investors before committing to construction. Multi brought established customers into the office development, including Cap Gemini, for which it had built premises previously. Detailed plans by the firm's T+T team were followed by commissions to outside architects, including Robert Stern.

Van Dam later co-founded Icon Yachts in Harlingen. Its commercial building programme used a common technical platform while allowing different designers to shape interiors and exterior profiles. Engineering the systems before cutting metal was intended to reduce reworking. The yard also worked with trade unions and educational institutions to train its workforce for yacht production.
